Dialogs.Dialog: The battery's almost dead. Shouldn't you charge it soon？
Huh？ What are you saying all of a sudden？ ...Someone's watching, you know.
Why do you have to say stuff like that right now？ ...You're an idiot.
For now... I'll pass. I mean... I want to treasure this sort of thing. Okay？
Hey... What time are you coming home today？ ...Not that I'm waiting or anything.
▲主人公＊▲. Have a good day. Yeah, do your best.
What about my goodbye kiss？ ...Just kidding, don't take it seriously. Getting your hopes up like an idiot.
▲主人公＊▲. You're back early. Yeah... welcome home.
▲主人公＊▲. Welcome home. Why don't you go ahead and eat？
▲主人公＊▲. Welcome home. Tired？ Hmph, you're just not trying hard enough.
Hey... If I cooked for you sometime, would that make you happy？
Man, you really look like you're enjoying your food. Not that I mind.
Was it good？ Yeah, yeah, good for you.
Make sure you brush your teeth, take a bath, and then go to bed.
Make sure you do the dishes when you're done eating. Got it？
Going to sleep already, huh... Not that I mind.
Hey. How about... a goodnight kiss？
So, what kind of stuff have you been into lately？
Sounds kind of interesting. Now I'm curious too.
Nothing？ Then find something before next time. It's a promise.
Oh yeah？ Tell me about it sometime, then.
What kind of music have you been listening to lately？
Oh, you've got good taste. That's right up my alley.
Nothing？ Want me to recommend something to you sometime, then？
Hey. Will you let me listen to it sometime？
What kind of TV shows do you usually watch？
What a coincidence! I love that show too.
Is it good？ Hmm... Maybe I'll check it out too.
Quick question. What do you think... my best feature is？
That makes it sound like I have nothing going for me.
...I see. I'll keep that in mind.
Quick question. What do you think of my hair right now？ Do you like it？
I see. Actually, I really like it too. Hehe.
...I see. I'll keep that in mind.
Quick question. What do you think of my taste in clothes？ Do you like it？
...I guess our tastes just don't match.
Hmm. Then will you pick out my clothes next time？
Hey. What are you doing right now？
Hmm. Maybe I'll try doing that too.
I see. Is it really that fun？
Hey, can I join you next time？
I can't sleep. Maybe... it's your fault.
Don't be stupid. Aren't you a little full of yourself？
Whenever I try to sleep, your face pops into my head... Idiot.
Hey... um... staying over was fun, right？
Me too... Yeah... Don't make me say any more than that.
I see. ...Then I won't go anymore. ...Just kidding.
Yeah... We can go again sometime.
Quick question. Hey, does it bother you when I cling to you like this？
I see. ...As long as it doesn't bother you, then good. Hehe.
I see... Then I'll walk a little further away.
If you don't mind... I... Idiot, don't make me say any more.
Hey. Weren't you just thinking about me？
I see. Hehe. I was thinking the same thing.
Liar. You've been staring at me with pervy eyes this whole time.
Hmm. Weren't you supposed to be on my side？
Hey, when do you feel the happiest？
Yeah... Being like this right now makes me happy, too.
I see. ...So that's another kind of happiness.
...I'm happy right now. Just having you right here next to me like this.
▲主人公＊▲. When you're with me, do you... Never mind, it's nothing.
...It's okay if I stay by your side, right？
▲主人公＊▲. As long as you're here with me, I don't feel lonely.
...Once we're on break, we can be together the whole time, right？
Hey... what would you do if I said I wanted a kiss？ ...Idiot, I'm just kidding.
You have something on your mouth. Want me to get it？ D-Don't expect me to baby you.
Hey. Give me your hand... Your hands... are bigger than I thought...
Even if the whole world turned against me, you'd still be on my side, right？
The spot next to you... is reserved for me.
Mmph, mmm... Getting warm makes me sleepy.
Hey. When the cherry blossoms bloom, let's go see them.
When it's this nice out, it makes me want to skip school.
...It's so hot I feel like I'm gonna melt. Want some ice cream？
Hey. How much longer do you think this heat's gonna last...？
What's fall all about...？ Reading, obviously.
Watching the dead leaves fall... feels kind of lonely. Don't you think？
Fall makes me think of bonfires. ...There's something nice about that sort of thing.
Brrr... The wind's gotten pretty cold.
Achoo. Warm me up, meow▼ ...Just kidding, meow.
I wonder if it'll snow this year？
Hey, what are you doing up at this hour？ Did you pull an all-nighter？
You're up early. Get up too early and people'll start calling you grandpa, you know？ Heheh.
What are you getting up this early for？ I'm still sleepy.
Breakfast？ Ah... I don't really feel like eating.
Hey. Are you a rice person at breakfast？ Or a bread person？ I think I'm a bread person.
I'm really not a morning person.
Sigh... I'm jealous you have so much energy this early.
I wonder why I'm so sleepy...
The day's only just getting started, huh.
Hey, it's snack time. Let's take a little break.
Working hard？ I'm still sleepy, though.
It's almost lunchtime. Are you hungry？
I'm finally starting to wake up.
Hey, have you decided what you're having for lunch today？
Half a day left, let's do our best... or whatever.
Hey. What'd you have for lunch today？
Once you're full, it really makes you want to take a nap, huh.
...I think I might take a little nap, if that's okay.
Just because you're sleepy doesn't mean you get to slack off.
It's almost snack time, you know？
A snack, huh... I'm in the mood for potato chips.
Hey. Have you thought about your plans for later？
Almost done for the day. Hang in there.
Oh, it's evening already. Not heading home yet？
I think... I might stop by the arcade on my way home.
What are you doing for dinner？ You shouldn't just eat canned mackerel all the time.
Aw, I wish I could've had dinner with you too.
Hey. Anything good on TV tonight？
At night... I start feeling kind of lonely...
Did you eat dinner？ Just thought I'd check.
Oh, homework... You wouldn't do it for me, would you？
Did you take a proper bath？ You'll catch a cold if you don't warm up.
Oh... a shooting star. Just kidding.
Getting sleepy yet？ I'm... mm... sleepy too.
At this hour, your bed really starts calling to you, huh.
Hey. Did you brush your teeth before bed？
Make sure everything's locked up before you go to sleep. Okay？
I'm... going to bed soon. Goodnight.
Let's talk a lot again tomorrow, okay？
...I wonder if you can see the stars at this hour.
You're still up. ...Are you going to be okay tomorrow？
Can't sleep？ I hear warm milk helps you fall asleep.
Not sleeping yet？ Tomorrow's a day off, so... want to stay up late？
Being awake while everyone else is asleep is kind of exciting, isn't it？
Hey... No, never mind. I wonder if I'll dream about you.
You're up early. Hm？ Wait, did you pull an all-nighter？
Morning. ...Wait, is it too early for that？
Coming to see me this many times in one day... Are you bored or something？ Just kidding. I'm glad.
You come to see me every day. ...I see. Hehe.
You really like looking at me that much, huh. ...Thanks. I guess.
We meet again. ...We run into each other a lot around this time.
You really treasure your memories with me, huh. Thanks.
Hey, you're not seeing some other girl, are you？ Jealous？ It's not like that.
Huh？ Did it get bigger in here？
You know, I've been dreaming about you a lot. Hehe, just a little more... or something.
Hey. You've been keeping at it every week, right？ Just a little more and you might have the whole set.
Look, I told you before, didn't I？ Not to turn the power off without saving. And you did it again today, didn't you？
Hey. I heard we can do all kinds of new things starting today？ ...I'm kind of looking forward to it.
Hey. Have you tried out the new things we can do yet？
There's so much I want to do, I don't know where to start.
Do you not want to see me anymore？
So you won't... kiss me anymore. Whatever, it's fine.
You said you'd always be on my side, even if no one else was. So that was a lie.
All I ever do is think about you... Idiot.
I really can't do this on my own after all...
You said you'd always be on my side... Idiot.
Why would you say something like that to me？
You're on my side even if the whole world is against me. Can I really believe that？
...Okay, got it. Then... let's kiss and make up. Mwah.
Does this... look good on me, I wonder？
Hehe. ...This might actually be pretty good.
Horoscopes, huh. They're silly, but maybe I'll check mine for once.
It said something good, so maybe I'll believe it.
Hmm... Well, that's how horoscopes usually go.
The worst. Wish I hadn't looked.
His fortune is... the very best？ It's a little annoying, but maybe I'll tell him later.
His fortune's pretty good. I'll tell him later.
His fortune's nothing special either way, huh. Kind of boring.
His fortune's the worst today. Well, it's just a horoscope anyway.
▲主人公＊▲. I wonder if he went home.
I wonder if ▲主人公＊▲ is waiting for me.
That brings me right back to life... Phew.
My skin... Wonder if it's nice and smooth now.
...Wonder if they've gotten a little bigger？
No way! This scale is definitely broken!
Wonder what size he likes. ...Not that I care or anything.
Maybe this is a little too plain.
This feels like I'm trying too hard... A bit weird, maybe.
What am I even worrying about...？ Who cares.
I wonder what kind he likes.
Wonder if he prefers them bigger, too... Sigh.
I wonder how I can get a better figure...
Why am I so hung up on what he thinks...？
Yeah! Nothing beats this right after a bath.
Huh？ Was this right？ Oh, whatever.
I think this should be fine, though.
Not bad, if I do say so myself! Bet he'll love it.
Made with plenty of love, too. No way it tastes bad.
Block there, then a light kick on wake-up...
I could've sworn I was playing a match against him...
Hey. Do you like... being hugged tight？
Never let your guard down. Light kick!
Not bad. Wouldn't expect any less from my rival.
Ugh, come on, that was playing dirty.
Kitty Rinko gets lonely easily, meow♪
I just wanna stay nice and warm like this, meow.
If you thought that's how this would go, think again!
Seriously, the second you see a cute girl, you go all goofy over her.
...Not that I'm calling myself cute, or anything...
A year really flies by, doesn't it？
Maybe... it's because I was with you？
Thirty seconds left... Oh, the countdown's starting.
▲主人公＊▲. Here's to another good year together...
This year... I want the two of us to have even more fun times together.
Hm？ You want me to pick something out for you？
Okay, then put the things you want me to choose between on my left and right.
Hmm... They both look good to me, though. I still have to pick one, right？
Which one's better... Oh, I know.
Geez... Don't make me make such a tough choice.
Besides, instead of relying on me, you should just pick for yourself.
Well, if you can't decide again, I guess you can ask me.
Hm？ Did something bad happen？ If you don't mind talking to me, I'll listen.
Look... I can tell when you're forcing yourself, you know.
Even I have days where I feel down.
You've always been there for me, right？ It's the same for me.
I'll stay by your side until you feel better.
If you stay this down, it's gonna make me sad too.
Well？ Does having me here not help...？
You know, I just want to see you smile.
▲主人公＊▲. Smile like you always do!
Heh... Feeling a little better now？
Come on, take a nice, deep breath.
Ready, go! ...Huh？ Wait, isn't that how you take a deep breath？
▲主人公＊▲. You know I'm always on your side, right？
Heh. ...Looks like your usual smile is finally back.
Look... All I can really do is listen, but you can lean on me when things get tough.
Um... Can I lie down next to you？
Want me to... lie down with you？ If you don't want me to, that's fine.
Are you asleep already...？ Um... I'll stay right here until you fall asleep.
Listen... Sorry for always being so selfish. Just get some good rest today, okay？
Aren't you going to sleep yet？
Look at you, sleeping so innocently.
*Yawn*... I'm getting sleepy too. Good night...
Hey. How about... a goodnight kiss？
Come on... Just go to sleep already.
Um... Weren't you tossing and turning and saying weird stuff just now？
Wake up! ...Sorry, you were groaning in your sleep, so I just reacted.
Mm？ Mmm... Huh？ Sorry... Looks like I fell asleep too. Morning.
Stretch together？ Mm... What a pain. Well, fine.
I haven't been getting enough exercise lately. So let's do it together.
Oh, so you're not doing it.
Feet shoulder-width apart, left hand on your hip, right arm up by your ear, and stretch... There.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight.
After I say 'one, two, three, four,' you follow up with 'five, six, seven, eight.' Got it？
Ready, and: one, two, three, four.
Come on, put some more energy into your voice.
Next, step one foot back and put your hands on your hips. Bend your right knee forward and keep your left leg straight back to stretch your Achilles tendon.
Last one. Feet together, hands in front of you, and bend down to touch your toes. Then come back up, hands on your hips, and lean back.
Okay, that's it for stretching. Did you do it properly？
You want to do push-ups？ Sure, I guess.
I haven't been getting enough exercise lately, so let's do it together.
Hey, want to do some push-ups with me？
Heh. Okay, let's both do our best.
...Oh. And here I wanted to do it together.
One set is ten push-ups. How many sets are you doing？
Well, that's probably just about right for you.
A guy should be able to do at least this much.
Are you sure you'll be okay？ You're not just trying to show off, are you？
Going for fifty？ I don't think you should push yourself too hard.
Seriously？ ...Well, if it gets to be too much, just stop halfway through.
Okay, let's get started. I'll count, so make sure you count out loud too.
Yeah, well done. That's my boyfriend for you.
That many？ ...You surprised me. I'm seeing you in a new light.
Good workout. It feels good to work up a sweat every now and then, right？
I'll wipe your sweat off. Come on, get over here.
Don't you think getting some exercise feels pretty healthy？
Maybe I'll try doing a few, too. Will you coach me？
Okay, go ahead. ...Go easy on me.
Hey, make sure you count properly.
Huff, huff... I don't think... I can go on...
Phew... I'm beat. Still, it feels nice to work out once in a while.
No good... I've hit my limit...
Good workout. Let's exercise together again sometime.
Whew... I worked up a sweat. I'm gonna go take a shower.
Hm？ Listen, if you try to peek, I'll kick you, okay？
One set is ten sit-ups. How many sets are you doing？
Wanna play a game together？ Hehe. You're a hundred years too early to challenge me.
Hey, wanna play a game together？
I see. Well, let's play some other time.
Nice! I'm gonna totally crush you again.
Sure. I'll be taking the win this time, too.
Hey, normally guys don't go all out against their girlfriend, right？
Hehe. Let's see what you've got.
Huh？ Quitting already？ Too bad. Let's play again sometime.
Hehe. That was fun. Wanna go another round？
Okay. Let's start from the beginning again.
Hehe. Did you have fun？ I sure did. Let's play again sometime.
I see... Sounds like you had a rough time...
When things are like this, come sit closer while we talk. Okay？
Remember how you once told me you were on my side？
Maybe you didn't mean anything huge by it, but for me...
It made me so happy back then... Because I'd always felt like I was all alone in the world.
Hearing you say you were on my side really saved me, you know？ Once you told me that...
I felt like I could forgive all the awful, sad things that had happened up until then.
Like no matter what happened anymore, we'd be able to laugh it off together.
So this time, it's my turn to say it.
I'm always on your side, okay？ Even if it's you against the world, I'll stick by you to the very end, no matter what.
Are you listening？ Even if someone says they don't want you around, I don't want a world without you in it.
If anyone ever says you're no good, I'll kick their butt for you. Got it？
Let's hold our heads high, okay？ Let's just laugh in their faces and say, "Doesn't bother me one bit, so take that!"
As long as we're together, we'll be fine. We're the ultimate tag team, after all.
From now on, whenever things get rough, lean on me once in a while.
I don't want to be the only one leaning on you all the time. I am your girlfriend, after all. Okay？
